[RTCT.6.8.1] **Canonical hash — omit-when-zero.** The caps join the
`ds.contract.v1` canonical serialization ([RBND.4b]) **only when
non-zero.** A cap-free contract therefore serializes byte-identically to
its form from before the cache caps existed: its `rt_config_sha256` is unchanged and no
existing `.dsrt` binding is revved. A contract that **declares** a cache
cap gets the extra canonical lines; a runtime predating the caps then
recomputes a mismatching hash and rejects the file ([RDSC.16.3.3]) — the
same reject-don't-skip gate. The Python
`canonical_bytes` and the C `emit_canonical` MUST apply omit-when-zero
identically.
